_comment: The jurisdictions of the documents (search/jurisdiction.py): a document takes the first jurisdiction whose pattern matches its designation (else the start of its title), else 'default'; its card field 'jurisdiction' wins when it has one. The 'home' ones answer (Russian, interstate CIS, EAEU, Kazakh and international documents); the 'extra' ones (American standards) come after them as a supplement, in places of their own, never instead of them. A question with the words of a jurisdiction ('ask') puts its documents first.

patterns: ^(СТ РК|СН РК|СП РК|РДС РК|МСН РК|НТП РК|ПР РК)\b
